title: Metastability and phase transition in a social network model with multiple opinions
summary: We consider a stochastic opinion dynamics model on a fully connected social network with $N$ actors interacting by expressing opinions from a set of $M$ opinions. At any time $t\geq 0$, each actor is associated to an $M$-tuple representing the social pressure exerted on this actor for each opinion. The evolution of the matrix containing the social pressure of all actors for all opinions is a Markov jump process.
